comment: dr peebles is a great guy, i would highly recommend him for the spanish com2 requirement. he's def the easiest prof to do spanish with, but he's also very knowledgeable and will actually teach you. he brings his dog to class, makes a lot of jokes, and always loves to talk about music after class. honestly made me want to add a spanish minor.

If you are going to take Dr. Peebles because you think it's an easy A, don't. 221 is hard, and he offers very little extra credit on assignments, which can make or break your grade in 221. He is not a very lenient grader, but he's a nice guy who makes the class interesting, and if you're lucky, he will bring his dog to class if no one's allergic

I loved Spanish with Prof Peebles. You have to work, but it is 100% manageable (seems easier than my friends' Spanish profs). He loves to make jokes, but that keeps the class engaging to sit through 5x a week. He does love to cold call, which definitely keeps you on your toes. I would retake Spanish just to have class with Peebles again.

Peebles was such a fun Spanish professor! Most of class you'll be answering questions, discussing in pairs, or going over past hw as a class. You will have to speak a lot but Peebles makes everyone comfortable and doesn't expect you to be perfect. I'm really glad I got in his class definitely take 221 with Peebles!

Peebles speaks a lot of english during class and gets off topic easily. He is funny and keeps the class interesting. The tests and homework are easy, it is not hard to get an A. He does regularly keep the class over, sometimes as long as 10 minutes!

Prof. Peebles brings a lot of energy to class(even at 8am) and expects participation but will help you find the right answer. The class is maybe 60:40 English to Spanish instruction. He enjoys pontificating randomly at length. Recommend for Spanish requirements, but not learning as the class isn't hard with 1-3 hrs of daily homework.

Spanish is by far my worst subject. Took class to complete COM2 requirement. He makes the class bearable even though I hate Spanish with a burning passion.  The VHL HW is pretty much useless for tests. However, his study guides are exactly like the tests. Spends most of the time telling stories in English but is available for help out of class.

This class is a lot of work but he makes it enjoyable. He is very kind and speaks 50/50 spanish and english. He is a great Spanish professor and tells hilarious stories. I would recommend him for the Spanish requirement!

What a funny dude. Ted Peebles is a legend. He will go on random tangents that take up the entire class period but he makes Spanish easy and digestable. Tests are literally the study guide word for word. He cares a lot about his students and is always happy to provide additional support inside and outside of class.
Really easy class but he talks nonstop about random things that are not part of the class. Definitely a little weird but he's sweet. Really likes fish sticks...?
He gets off topic easily and tells many funny stories.

Professor Peebles is awesome. He has so much knowledge beyond spanish and will certainly share it with you (he tends to go on long off-topic tangents). Regardless, he made spanish fun and EASY. If you do the homework, show up, and pay attention, Spanish with Ted Peebles is a guaranteed A. Highly recommend.

T. Peebles is one of the most engaging professors I've ever had. I took LAIS221 during may term and it was an absolute grind. That said, he is a fair grader, and is willing to work with students put in the time. Dude is extremely knowledgable, so expect some hour-long tangents about drug wars, history, etc. Just show him u care and it will pay off.

He gets distracted and monologues quite frequently, making for a boring 5 day a week class. Unfortunately, he gets so caught up he rushes through the material he actually needs to teach. Super easy class if you took Spanish before and are willing to put in the work outside of class. His tests are straightforward and his extra credit opp. is godly.

Ted Peebles is a true asset to UR. One of the best professors, Spanish or otherwise, I've ever had. He's hilarious, knows an endless supply of interesting/random cultural facts, and can clearly teach Spanish concepts. 221 is an annoying, difficult class by nature, but Peebles makes it bearable. Fair grader, tests not too bad. A must for Com2!

Dr. Peebles was one of a kind. I've always struggled with languages and he did an incredible job of making me feel comfortable with learning Spanish. Not only that but but he was just a great guy to talk to about well anything. Looking back, I'm so glad took him because he made me fall in love with Spanish. Definitely one of the best profs at UR.

First of all, he is a great dude. Real funny and willing to push the envelope a little bit. If you put in some kind of consistent effort, you're golden. Just show that you're making an effort. Class is always entertaining, as Peebles is quite the storyteller.
Gets off topic very easily. Not demanding, just boring. Nature of class (class schedule) makes it annoying, but definitely one of the easier professors.

He is an absolutely great professor when he is willing to explain the material but he often spends time just reviewing homework out of the text book. His tests are very hard to make an A on but getting a B is easy. He has so much potential to be a great Spanish instructor but doesn't live up to it.

Peebles is the best professor I've had at Richmond.  He really loves Spanish.  He also loves his wife and kids... and spends a lot of time talking about them in class.  He gets off topic easily but the class is a breeze.  I got an A on every test.  Offers lots of extra credit.  Very helpful outside of class.

If you are looking to just fulfill your language requirement, take Peebles. He talks in english for about ninety percent of the class so it is way less intense than other spanish classes. His tests are pretty hard to get A's on, but you can definitely get a B. Lots of homework, but you can speed through it.

Peebles has more stories than he has time for. You will not learn Spanish if you take him. You will learn a lot about a lot of random topics but Spanish won't be one of them. However, he will expect you to learn Spanish but over all he is pretty easy and speaks a lot of English in class.

Peebles is great.  He assigns a little more homework than other professors but is very lenient about the due dates.  He can be a little scatterbrained but overall he sticks to the syllabus.  His tests just get easier and easier, and the projects are actually fun to do.  Always speaks alot of English in class so he's easy to understand.

His stories are amazing and he has really simple methods for teaching stuff that the book makes seem complicated. Nightly homework, but it takes less than 45 mintues. Tests are fair and he tells you exactly what to study for. A great teacher to get you to fall in love with Spanish.

awesome guy. take him if you want an easy grade to fulfill a requirement but not the best if you actually want to learn Spanish. makes class fun and he's really funny and gets sidetracked really easily.
Peebles is the man. enough said

With Peebles, you'll learn a lot about random things. You'll learn about foreign cultures, interesting books, linguistics, but when it comes to spanish? He's very knowlegeable, but gets off topic a lot, because he loves to talk about, well, anything. You won't learn as much spanish as you would in other classes. A fun, relaxed spanish course.

Peebles is the best language instructor I've ever had. His lectures are clear, his explanations instructive. He's also very funny. No language course is easy--that is the nature of the material--but Peebles makes Spanish enjoyable. If you put in a moderate amount of work outside of the classroom, you can pull an A.

Peebles is the man! By far, best prof. I've had at UR so far.  This guy loves to talk, especially in English after you get past the first week.  Tests arent bad especially if you study and he's got a great sense of humor.

Very funny and reasonable guy, smart too. You learn what you need to know and the class is very layed back and entertaining. Sometimes just talk in english about world events the whole time. Tests are a little tricky, but Spanish doesn't get a whole lot easier

from my experience i have never had a teacher that has been more concerned with his students learning things the right way.  He takes extra time and care to make sure you understand the material.  He goes beyond teaching spanish to make sure you understand the important things in life.
Very cool Prof.

Great great guy, class is exciting.  Even a mayterm class that lasts four hours  a day was enjoyable with Peebles.  Its a language so take it for what it is on easiness.  Would recommend him to anyone looking ot fulfill his/her language requirement!!!
gets easily distracted. doesn't speak spanish. talks a lot about nothing. pulls a lot of info right from his butt, i think.  a nice guy.
It has been a few years since i took his course but I am still grateful to have had him as a teacher. He is a great guy and I enjoyed every day in his class, even at 8:15.

God, does he ever have a point?  Does he ever speak in Spanish?  Does he ever keep to his syllabus? Does he ever stop spewing his political ideology?  Unlike a lot of people, I wanted to learn Spanish, and we didn't learn anything I hadn't
Hes a good guy and if you keep up with the work its not that bad.  He goes off on random tangents a lot, but hes a good teacher.
He's easily distracted and class is always fun. We don't always cover a lot of the material because he'd rather discuss politics or his kids.
